name: aromir_acceptance_invariance
purpose: TASKS 267 / TASKS 269 criterion 3 (registration GoalGathering/notes/PreRegistration_2026-11-18_aromir_Acceptance.md): v1.4's spread under a rotation, the mirror image and another atom order, with aromir's own code and the bundled release of the clean WSL install (reinstalled at the landed main commit), on stored B3LYP geometries and Hessians — v1.3's trials: seven molecules x (12 xyz listings, 8 rotations, the mirror image), three molecules x 5 SMILES-writing orders. Writes invariance_measured.json and atom_order_spread.json; their numbers go into aromir's v1.4 folder after a review. No quantum chemistry. Dry run on 18 Nov: benzene alone in 16 s, 0.35 GB.

estimate.basis: the dry run: one molecule's 21 presentations in 16 s on one thread; the seven molecules are 12-24 atoms, and the order part 15 presentations

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops the run at 1024 MB; the dry run peaked at 0.35 GB max RSS
